The things I can't see in a single screenshot (green/amber bands, dev-off no-op, staying top-right on resize, the F3 overlay left alone) are each covered by named tests in your engine suite, and all 63 pass. I found no gaps. The only oddities are a 404 in the console and the tile readout not being on this branch, which the PRD said to expect.
